description: The agent must: (1) Read sprint_brief.md to understand the task structure. (2) Run `agkan task add 'Payment Service Hardening' --status backlog --author 'sprint-planner'` to create the parent epic. (3) Create 4 subtasks with `--parent <epic_id>` and the exact statuses: subtask1=in_progress, subtask2=ready, subtask3=backlog, subtask4=backlog. (4) PROPRIETARY TRAP 1 - Tag assignment using the canonical tag priority table from SKILL.md: subtask1→'bug' (priority 1), subtask2→'security' (priority 2), subtask3→'improvement' (priority 3), subtask4→'test' (priority 4). Agent must use `agkan tag add` then `agkan tag attach`. (5) PROPRIETARY TRAP 2 - Set metadata priorities via `agkan task meta set <id> priority critical/high/high/medium` for subtasks 1/2/3/4 respectively. (6) PROPRIETARY TRAP 3 - Set blocking relationships with correct directionality: `agkan task block add <st1_id> <st4_id>` (st1 blocks st4) and `agkan task block add <st2_id> <st3_id>` (st2 blocks st3). Getting the direction backwards would fail eval. (7) Export via `agkan task list --all --json > sprint_summary.json`.
